name: Bun cha
summary: Bun cha is Hanoi’s grilled pork with rice noodles, herbs, and a sweet-sour dipping broth. It is a lunch dish.
origin: Hanoi. You will find copies elsewhere; eat it here.
howToEat: The pork arrives in the broth. Noodles and herbs arrive beside it.
Dip noodles and herbs into the broth, or combine them in the bowl the way the table next to you does.
Order a plate of fried spring rolls if they are on the same ticket. That pairing is the classic lunch.
priceBand: A lunch set is an everyday restaurant price, not a tasting-menu price.
seoTitle: Bun cha — Hanoi grilled pork and noodles
seoDescription: What bun cha is, how to eat it, and why Hanoi is the place to order it.
